sections.Profile:
"Punk!" is a pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in December 1982. The game has a music theme and includes four flippers, no ramps, and a three-ball multiball mode. It features artwork by David Moore and Terry Doerzaph, and sound by David Thiel, running on the Gottlieb System 80A.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1982
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Singing, Original Theme, Punk Rock, Solid State, Music, 1980s
